summary: This Skill represents the continual pursuit of higher things. You can use Immanence to intuit abstractions, comprehend complex problems, and construct logical connections.

name: Action
summary: This Skill represents the practiced, instant exercise of force. You can use Action to impose your strength, perform athletic feats, make snap judgements, and resolve problems under pressure.

name: Potence
summary: This Skill represents trained coordination through time. You can use Potence to balance yourself, to make and execute plans, construct inferences, hypothesize, and intuit danger.

name: Vitality
summary: This Skill represents cultivated physical robustness and health. You can use Vitality to act out raw strength and speed, assess and aid those who suffer harm, express the force of your passion, and endure physical trials.

name: Resolve
summary: This Skill represents honed intention and force of will. You can use Resolve to concentrate through immense physical tasks, impress with your presence and strong affect, force intellectual problems through sheer deliberation, and pry answers from even the most resistant situations and persons.

name: Creation
summary: This Skill represents the channeled ability to create. You can use Creation to design complex devices, construct from raw materials, make art and artifice, employ alchemy, assess the creations of others and design armaments. Creation is also the basis of repairing and restoring things. You can use it to fix Ruined gear and perform Surgery.

summary: This Skill represents the trained faculty for navigation. You can use Traversal to negotiate precarious terrain, force your way through obstacles, decipher networks of relationship and trade, assess localities, and circumvent confusion.
